color.name: color-surface
color.usage: Cards, rows, bars, sheets: anything that sits on the background.

color.name: color-surface-muted
color.usage: Quiet areas inside a surface: inputs at rest, table headers, placeholders.

color.name: color-line
color.usage: Borders and dividers. Never for text.

color.name: color-ink-muted
color.usage: Secondary text: subtitles, captions, hints, inactive tabs.

color.name: color-accent
color.usage: Brand colour: the main action, links, selected states.

color.name: color-accent-soft
color.usage: Secondary buttons, selected rows and chips.

color.name: color-success-soft
color.usage: Background of success banners and badges.

color.name: color-warning-soft
color.usage: Background of warning banners and badges.

color.name: color-danger-soft
color.usage: Background of error banners and badges.

color.name: color-scrim
color.usage: Dims the screen behind sheets and dialogs.

font.name: font-sans
font.usage: The only typeface. Swap it here to change the look of the whole product.

type.name: text-display
type.usage: Hero numbers and headlines on landing, empty and success states.

type.name: text-title
type.usage: Screen and page titles, one per screen.

type.name: text-heading
type.usage: Section headings, row and card titles, button labels.

type.name: text-caption
type.usage: Meta information under a title; tab labels; badges.

space.name: space-half
space.usage: Between a title and its subtitle.

space.name: space-1
space.usage: Label to field; icon to its text in tight places.

space.name: space-2
space.usage: Between items in a list or a button group.

space.name: space-4
space.usage: Mobile screen side padding; card padding.

space.name: space-5
space.usage: Between sections; space under bottom bars (home indicator).

space.name: space-6
space.usage: Web page padding; large gaps on empty and success states.

space.name: space-8
space.usage: Between major page regions on web.

shadow.name: shadow-overlay
shadow.usage: Sheets and dialogs above the scrim.

motion.name: motion-fast
motion.usage: Press feedback and small state changes (switch, checkbox).

motion.name: motion-base
motion.usage: Elements appearing: banners, sheets, screen transitions.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.usage: Default easing for anything that enters.
